text: So if you try to process trauma while you're above this red line, you're adding to the armor instead of taking it off. In that state your functional IQ drops a lot, and the Nucleus Accumbens gets flooded with the catecholamines that transcribe new DeltaFosB proteins, the "armor" itself.
reader: someone with trauma who gets triggered and tries to think their way out of it, wanting to know why that fails and when to do trauma work
